query: The Fern on the Sill You're tired, and there are lectures at eight, and there's a fern on your windowsill, green and full of life it isn't using. Siphon is right there in your hands. Nobody would ever know but the fern. Just a little The fern greys from the tips inward. You feel wonderful. You throw the fern out in the morning, before anyone sees it. Go to bed tired You go to bed tired, and wake tired, and the fern is green. You water it, which feels like an apology to something.
